title: Functorial Kunneth spectral sequence reindexing
statement: In an abelian category, an E1 cohomological spectral sequence E [def-sp-spectral-sequence] reindexes functorially to an E2 cohomological spectral sequence by Enew_r^(p,q) = E_(r-1)^(-q,p+2q). Its successor homology isomorphisms are the restriction-homology isomorphisms followed by those of E. The reindexing preserves vanishing of incoming and outgoing differentials and the normalized stationary equation iCycles followed by the inverse comparison equals homology projection, successor isomorphism and the next inverse comparison.

source.place: Tag 0H7Z, the final change of indices in the proof of lemma-kunneth-spectral-sequence

proof.text: The map (p,q) to (-q,p+2q) is injective. It takes (r,1-r) to (r-1,2-r), so it defines a shape embedding preserving and reflecting the relation. Integer arithmetic also identifies predecessors and successors.

Restrict page r-1 along this embedding. Compose the canonical restriction-homology comparison with the old successor isomorphism. Restriction of page maps defines the functor, since naturality of the homology comparison and the old successor square give the new square.

The restriction-cycle isomorphism commutes with iCycles and with the homology projection. Precompose the old stationary equation with it to prove the new equation. The predecessor and successor equalities identify the new differentials with the old zero differentials.

theorem kunnethReindex_successor (E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence C 1)
    (pq : ℤ × ℤ) (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (A : C)
    (e : A ≅ (E.page (r - 1) (by omega)).X (kunnethIndex pq))
    (e' : A ≅ (E.page ((r + 1) - 1) (by omega)).X (kunnethIndex pq))
    (h : (E.page (r - 1) (by omega)).iCycles (kunnethIndex pq) ≫ e.inv =
      (E.page (r - 1) (by omega)).homologyπ (kunnethIndex pq) ≫
        (E.iso (r - 1) ((r + 1) - 1) (kunnethIndex pq) (by omega) (by omega)).hom ≫
          e'.inv) :
    ((kunnethReindex E).page r hr).iCycles pq ≫ e.inv =
      ((kunnethReindex E).page r hr).homologyπ pq ≫
        ((kunnethReindex E).iso r (r + 1) pq rfl hr).hom ≫ e'.inv
